scripts.build: npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
